data.label: include
data.reason_zh: SkillMorph 用执行轨迹定位技能缺陷并改写可复用技能文件，演化后的技能用于后续评估与实际 PR，符合外部工件持续改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Specifically, SkillMorph compares failure and success evidence in abstracted trajectories across repeated runs and tasks, incorporating changes between evolution loops to identify suspicious actions.
scope_support.object_quote: It then uses these suspicious actions to localize edit sites in the skills and generate corresponding revisions.
scope_support.persistence_quote: the skills evolved by SkillMorph consistently achieve higher trial-level accuracy and execution consistency than the original skills
